title: •At Last We Are Getting Results
caption: •At Last We Are Getting Results (V)
game_text: If Invasion on table, deploy on table. Maul ignores objective deployment restrictions. Your {presence} droids are defense value +2. Your starships are deploy -1. Immunity to attrition of opponent’s cards is -3. {alter}
lore: First sign that your blockade is going well: the Queen’s on the comlink.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. NEW base set for the remaster: Theed Palace (expansion ring icon not cut yet; the printed card also shows the Episode I icon under the Theed sphere beside the lore box). Inline icon in 'Your [icon] droids' = small red square with a white battle-droid figure = the Presence icon → {presence} (the PC's own Virtual Block 5 reissue text in gempdata/DarkLegacy.json reads 'Your [Presence] droids'); the wiki stub's game_text_note names it 'Trade Federation' — wrong. Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. Margin credits printed vertically, one line each: left 'Original concept by Michael Richards', right 'Oklahoma States 2004'. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Queen’s (wiki straight). Copyright line read off the 350 px scan: '© 2001 LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 2001 DECIPHER INC.' (low-res). Base scan only 350 px (Theed-D-atlastwearegettingresults.gif). Modern: Virtual Block 5 only (VB5-D-atlastwearegettingresults-pre.gif, 350 px; non-pre also exists).
